decisions.reason: Adding refrigerators to the furnished drawing does not change the requirement to annotate room dimensions.
The refrigerator-display instruction applies to the separate furnished layout and does not alter the floor-plan deliverable format or required-content definition.
The furnished-layout refrigerator addition does not change Unit 2 bathroom placement, partitioning, fixtures, plumbing, or door position.
The source modification does not establish any change to Unit 3 bathroom placement, plumbing, partitioning, or door-clearance requirements.
Showing refrigerators in the furnished drawing does not necessarily change the number, configuration, or dimensions of the kitchen cabinets.
The source decision does not affect the Unit 1 toilet location or its drain-alignment constraint.

The source message also mentions removing purple-marked walls and leaving the area beside a counter empty, but the supplied context does not establish that this is Unit 3 or how it changes the existing red-wall and yellow-area counter strategy.
The furnished-layout refrigerator instruction does not affect retention or shared use of the existing main entrance.
